text: Maaku an Nulaaɗo: "Men gomɗinii Alla Reweteeɗo, men ɗoftike Mo e kon ko O Yamiri men, men gomɗinii on wahyu jippinaaɗo e amen, e kon ko jippii e dow Ibraahiima e Ismaa'iila e Ishaaqa e Yaaquuba, e kon ko jippinaa e dow Annabaaɓe ɓen immorde e geɗalɓe Yaaquuba, e kon ko Muusaa e Iisaa e Annabaaɓe ɓen denndaangal okkaa immorde e Defte e Aayeeje Iwɗe ka Joomi maɓɓe. Men serndataa hakkunde maɓɓe gomɗingol yoga yedda yoga, menen ko men jebbilaniiɓe Alla Tan".
